rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a concrete place or thing situated by the coast.

example.english: This coastal restaurant has a great atmosphere at night.
example.traditional: 呢間海邊嘅餐廳夜晚好有氣氛。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 hoi2 bin1 ge3 caan1 teng1 je6 maan5 hou2 jau5 hei3 fan1

rows.note: Use this for the broader formal or written sense of relating to or extending along the coast.

example.english: The coastal region will build a large wind farm.
example.traditional: 沿海地區將興建大型風力發電站。
example.jyutping: jyun4 hoi2 dei6 keoi1 zoeng1 hing1 gin3 daai6 jing4 fung1 lik6 faat3 din6 zaam6
